terms.definition: How strongly a material opposes the flow of current.
terms.function: The drag the current pushes through, on every road it travels.
terms.whyItMatters: It is the dimmer switch of every circuit.
Resistor bands, wire charts, and appliance data all speak in ohms.

terms.definition: Ohm's-law relation linking push, drag, and flow.
terms.whyItMatters: One line explains brighter dimmer, heating, and fuse behavior.
terms.whereItIs: The ammeter's needle reacting to the block.

terms.definition: The geometric knobs of resistance: longer and thinner paths fight more.
terms.whyItMatters: Why bulb filaments are long and coils, why house wires are thick.
